collection.browser: Playwright Chromium; anonymous separate contexts; ko-KR; 1440x1000
collection.method: domcontentloaded then 4.5 seconds; no sign-in or DOM edits; original HTML/screenshots stored only in ignored .tmp/light-dom-holdout
collection.candidatePolicy: Unmodified v1 generic collector plus v2 observation enrichment; first eight exact-value candidate groups; add none; deterministic SHA256 shuffle by case+candidate ID; no label-based insertion or pruning
collection.annotationMethod: Agent review of anonymous live DOM captures, rendered screenshots, metadata and local node relationships before any evaluated model output. Candidate inputs were built using the fixed first-eight policy before labels were attached.
collection.task: Current work title, representative artwork, and series/movie plot synopsis element selection. Not search result matching or navigation success.

modelIsolation: All previously scored 66 cases are development. New candidate inputs, labels and annotations stay unread by model/template authors until all choices are frozen. The dataset annotator sees pages and gold but no evaluated model outputs. Input JSON contains observed evidence only.
limitations: Same four established provider layouts; new works and two new non-detail page types. Six page clusters, not eighteen independent sites. Anonymous access, not authenticated catalogue coverage. One empty concrete image pool is trivial and must be distinguished in results.
